timeline.title: What Happens Next
timeline.sub: We treat every pitch seriously — here is how the process works.

step1.title: You submit
step1.body: Share your pitch, links, and where you believe you can create value.

step2.title: We review
step2.body: Our team reads every submission and checks fit against current business needs.

step3.title: Conversation
step3.body: Promising pitches lead to a short call or message exchange.

step4.title: Next steps
step4.body: If there is mutual fit, we discuss collaboration — employment, freelance, or partnership.

faq1.q: Is this a traditional job application?
faq1.a: No. We want you to study our business directions first, then pitch specific value you can create — not send a generic CV blast.

faq2.q: Do I need to tick all three solution chips?
faq2.a: No — but you should understand at least one area well enough to explain where you can help.

faq3.q: What collaboration types do you consider?
faq3.a: Full-time, part-time, freelance, commission-based, internship, and partnership models — depending on the person and the opportunity.

faq4.q: Why do you require an accessible CV link?
faq4.a: Link-based submissions fail when Google Drive or portfolio permissions are restricted. Please set sharing to "Anyone with the link can view".

faq5.q: How long until I hear back?
faq5.a: We aim to review submissions within one to two weeks. Strong, specific pitches may hear back sooner.

faq6.q: Can I apply from outside Singapore?
faq6.a: Yes. Bao Service operates across Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia. Remote and regional collaboration may be possible depending on the role.
